prompt:
Workflow step: Use the mobile robot arm to move the mold from mobile robot platform to workbench.
Inspection timing: before this step
Inspection location: mobile robot platform
What the inspection checks: Check whether a mold is on mobile robot platform.

A description of the inspection camera's photograph follows, written by someone who was not told what is being checked.

Description: A white plastic worktop/platform photographed from above, resting on a dark grey tiled floor visible along the right edge and bottom. The plate has a long rectangular recessed slot at the left side and many small drilled holes and shallow circular recesses across its surface.

Four square white holder blocks, each with screws at the corners, are mounted on the plate: one upper-left with a round white cap or disc seated in its central opening; one upper-right with an empty round central bore; one lower-centre with an empty round recess; and one lower-left holding a dark teal/black screw-cap fitting with a pale blue-green centre and a small white loop or tab projecting to its lower left. Two more white caps appear at the top edge.
observations: The platform shows only holder blocks with caps/vials and empty bores; no mold is visible on the mobile robot platform, so the move step has nothing to pick up.

args.observations: The platform shows only holder blocks with caps/vials and empty bores; no mold is visible on the mobile robot platform, so the move step has nothing to pick up.
